normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter only exists to feed the public transfer entry point.
The amount parameter only matters as the argument of the public transfer call.
The spender parameter is only meaningful as input to approve.
The account parameter only targets the owner-only exclusion routine.
tAmount is only consumed by the public reflect routine and its fee math.
The local tFee is the direct result of the guarded fee arithmetic operation.
The local rAmount is only used to debit _rOwned inside _transferStandard.
The local currentRate is only the intermediate rate consumed by _getValues.
